name: Kestrel
postCreateCommand: cp .env.example .env 2>/dev/null; pip install -e '.[dev]' && cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p data && alembic upgrade head

postAttachCommand.server: echo 'Servers auto-start via .vscode/tasks.json. If not running, run task: Tasks: Run Task → Start Backend / Start Frontend (or check Terminal panel for KESTREL-SERVERS terminals).'
